Farmer's guide

Practical checklists for a better season and a fairer price.

Before sowing

  • Test soil — know pH and nutrients before buying fertiliser
  • Buy certified seed with germination % on the packet
  • Service pump, drip lines and sprayer before the season rush
  • Book labour and transport early for harvest week

Sell for a better price

  • Grade and pack — sorted produce earns more than mixed lots
  • Photograph in daylight and state the harvest date honestly
  • Quote price per clear unit (kg, dozen, litre, bag)
  • Sell in smaller lots to households, bulk to hotels & shops

Buy safely, every time

  • Call the seller and confirm quantity before travelling
  • Check seed / fertiliser seals and expiry on delivery
  • Agree pickup or delivery cost before confirming
  • Pay on pickup or delivery unless you know the seller well
